title: SignalRecord
description: One JSONL line. Schema evolution: every file carries schema_version, starting at 1. A reader that encounters a schema_version higher than the one it knows REFUSES the document — it never best-efforts; the validator reports this as a distinctly named schema_version_too_new violation. Adding a value to an enum bumps schema_version if and only if some consumer branches on that enum with a documented default or else path. No bump: tools, profile.allow grants, permission_mode, isolation, agent, return.kind. Bump: outcome, level, escalate_to, postcondition. When in doubt, bump. There is deliberately no dispatch_id field: the filename carries it and the attestation log records it independently. Parent-side read rules: the level enum is closed and enforced at read time, advisory at write time; an unknown level is read as progress; at most 5 signals are relayed per dispatch; relays are at least 30 s apart; message is truncated to 200 chars before relay, not at write — the write-time bound is 2000; over-limit and malformed lines are recorded, not relayed.
